title: Move Your Own Piece
setup: Your pawn on b7 is one square from a new queen, and the square is occupied by your own knight.
hint: The knight has to leave, and Black must not be handed a free move to organize a blockade.
explanation:
## The Idea

The knight on b8 is standing in its own pawn's way. {{Nc6+}} steps aside with check, so there is no time for Black to cover b8; after {{Kd7}} the pawn walks in with {{b8=Q}}. Clear a queening square with tempo, never quietly.
